name: Miller Yang
source:
A young police officer recently graduated from a police academy. Possesses a strong sense of justice, eager to help the people of Bedjan. He is a bit of a glutton and likes visiting top-class restaurants.
[spoiler]In reality, he is the younger brother of [url=/c103259]Enzo Kent[/url]. It was his older brother that instructed him to infiltrate the police forces and help him achieve his goals - all in the name of justice.[/spoiler]
